content_en.prompt: Shruti finds a book instantly using a system: take the first letters of each title word, convert to numbers via a table, then repeatedly (multiply by 2, add next letter's number) for all 4 letters. Look up the book at [row = second-to-last digit, column = last digit] of the result (ignoring all but the last two digits if over 99).
content_en.question: In which bay can you find the book "How to Avoid Falling Trees"?
content_en.explanation: Following the calculation steps exactly as described (converting H-T-A-F-T's relevant letters, then the multiply-by-2-and-add sequence) gives a result whose last two digits point to row 2, column 4.
content_en.ct_explanation: This is the concept of hashing: a hash value is calculated from an item's properties (here, a title) to determine its storage location, avoiding a slow linear search through every item. Real systems (libraries, pharmacies) use hashing for even distribution, with collision-handling strategies when two items hash to the same location.

content_zh.prompt: Shruti有一套系統可以立刻找到書：取書名每個單字的第一個字母，用對照表換成數字，然後依序做「乘以2再加上下一個字母的數字」，總共套用4個字母。用結果數字的[列＝倒數第二位、欄＝最後一位]去查書架位置（如果結果超過99，只看最後兩位數字）。
content_zh.question: 《How to Avoid Falling Trees》這本書放在哪個書格？
content_zh.explanation: 完全依照說明的計算步驟（把H-T-A-F-T相關字母換算，再依序「乘2加下一個字母數字」）算出來的結果，最後兩位數字對應到第2列第4欄。
content_zh.ct_explanation: 這正是「雜湊」(hashing)的概念：從一項物品的屬性（這裡是書名）計算出一個雜湊值，決定它的儲存位置，避免要逐一線性搜尋所有物品。現實系統（圖書館、藥局）用雜湊來讓資料平均分布，並在兩項物品雜湊到同一位置時，用特定策略處理這種「碰撞」。
